text:
ANTIFRAUD::alert_html
Description
This iRules command returns the whole HTML in an escaped base64
format. (For js_vhtml alert.)
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
alert_html
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
{
log
local0.
"Alert HTML: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_html]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
